abstract: Recurrence of ovarian teratomas was evaluated in a randomised trial to determine whether laparoscopic cystectomy had the same efficacy as laparotomy. Forty premenopausal non-pregnant women with a unilateral teratoma no larger than 10 cm were randomised to laparoscopy or laparotomy. Post-operative pain, duration of stay in hospital and duration of convalescence were compared. Women were reviewed every six months for five years. A higher proportion had milder pain, faster hospital discharge and faster recovery following laparoscopy than laparotomy. There were no recurrences of teratomas in both arms of the study, suggesting that laparoscopy has the same efficacy as laparotomy.
abstract_ja:
目的：卵巣奇形腫の再発を、腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術と開腹術の有効性を比較するランダム化試験で評価した。
方法：片側性で最大径10cm以下の奇形腫を有する閉経前の非妊娠女性40例を、腹腔鏡群と開腹群に無作為に割り付けた。術後疼痛、入院期間、回復期間を比較した。女性は6か月ごとに5年間経過観察された。
結果：腹腔鏡群は開腹群に比べて軽度の疼痛、より早い退院、より早い回復を示す割合が高かった。両群とも奇形腫の再発はなかった。
結論：腹腔鏡手術は開腹術と同等の有効性を持つことが示唆される。
